title: Pioneer mission tenth planet covered up (Matt LaCroix claim)
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Pioneer mission tenth planet covered up (Matt LaCroix claim), about 1990s at Outer solar system, beyond the Kuiper Belt, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Outer solar system, beyond the Kuiper Belt

tellings.quote: And then the crazier thing is he said they covered up the presence of this tenth planet because this planet was four to five times larger than the Earth.
